subject: Production latency & 5xx surge — KV prefetch misalignment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@horizonai.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: horizonai-support@horizonai.com
Date: 2028-07-24T22:03:00Z
Subject: Severe latency and 5xxs - production inference

Laura,

We're seeing a sharp spike in p99 latency (from ~120ms to ~1.8s) and a 4.6% 5xx rate starting ~21:50 UTC across our production inference cluster backed by your hosted endpoints. Throughput (rps) is steady — this looks like internal head-of-line queuing rather than upstream traffic volume. Key observations from our side: 1) errors correlate with tenant-specific hot keys for long-context prompts, 2) the pattern started after your recent runtime kernel update (v4.3.1) and a change flagged by our infra: "prefetch_depth: auto" to "prefetch_depth: 12".

We've attached a short metrics snapshot (horizon_incident_metrics.png). This is impacting our customer-facing SLAs; our CTO Elena is requesting an ETA and mitigation plan. Can you confirm whether Redwood can make an immediate config rollback / targeted hotfix to KV prefetch behavior? If needed, we can open a maintenance window.

Samir
Head of Platform, HorizonAI

Quick triage notes (prelim):
- Confirmed: config_diff shows a staged change to prefetch_depth for tenant horizon_ai_tenant_id=hz-8421; new value = 12 (was 4). Change was auto-promoted during the v4.3.1 rollout window at 21:42 UTC.
- Observed: their request histogram shows ~3 hot prefixes responsible for ~60% of recent requests; when prefetch_depth increased we see evictions and lively kv cache churn on that shard group. Prefetch is pulling longer prefix chains, which is starving the hot-lane worker and creating HOL blocking for other concurrent requests targeted at that lane.

Mitigation plan (immediate, low-risk):
1) Reduce prefetch_depth for hz-8421 to 2 (targeted per-tenant override).
2) Pin their hot prefix shards to dedicated hot-lane for 30 minutes (reduce contention).
3) Temporarily lower worker preemption threshold to avoid long-running prefetch tasks blocking short requests.

Rollback plan: revert per-tenant override + unpin shards, will take <4 minutes. I'll prepare a config diff (config_diff_kv_prefetch.yaml). Risk: brief spike in miss-rate while prefetch is reduced; expect p50/p90 to improve within 60s and p99 within 3-5 minutes.

Requesting approval to apply mitigation now (no infra deploy needed; control-plane config push). ETA for change + validation: 10-15 minutes. I recommend we also schedule a post-mortem to tune prefetch heuristics for long-context tenants.

Marcus Lin
Runtime Lead, Redwood Inference
